hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; case "$f" in /*) abs="$f";; *) abs="$root/$f";; esac; [ -f "$abs" ] || exit 0; case "$abs" in "$root"/services/go/*.go) d=$(dirname "$abs"); gofmt -w "$abs"; cd "$d" && go vet . ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; case "$f" in /*) abs="$f";; *) abs="$root/$f";; esac; [ -f "$abs" ] || exit 0; case "$abs" in "$root"/airflow/*.py) cd "$root/airflow" && uv run ruff check "$abs" ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; case "$f" in /*) abs="$f";; *) abs="$root/$f";; esac; [ -f "$abs" ] || exit 0; case "$abs" in "$root"/services/frontend/*.ts|"$root"/services/frontend/*.tsx) cd "$root/services/frontend" && node_modules/.bin/eslint "$abs" || exit 2 ;; esac; }
